name: Splice
description: Splice MCP Server provides access to discovery and ideation tools that empower music creators with the power of Splices's extensive catalog of royalty-free samples. The Describe a Sound (Beta) tool enables search via natural language to find just the right sound. The Create tool builds stacks of complementary sounds that can inspire your next project. More tools will be added over time to the Splice MCP Server that bring more of the capabilities of Splice to your workflows.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Splice to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Splice to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.splice.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Splice MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Splice provides these MCP tools: describe_a_sound, create_stack, prompt_to_stack, share_stack, and download_asset.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Splice?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Splice in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
Splice requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Splice is developed by Splice. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
